mapper.select: SELECT s.SURVEY_ID, s.TITLE, s.DESCRIPTION, s.STATUS, s.CREATED_BY, s.CREATED_AT, s.END_DATE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SURVEY_RESPONSE r WHERE r.SURVEY_ID = s.SURVEY_ID) AS RESPONSE_COUNT FROM SURVEY s ORDER BY s.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT s.SURVEY_ID, s.TITLE, s.DESCRIPTION, s.STATUS, s.CREATED_BY, s.CREATED_AT, s.END_DATE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SURVEY_RESPONSE r WHERE r.SURVEY_ID = s.SURVEY_ID) AS RESPONSE_COUNT FROM SURVEY s WHERE s.SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId}
SELECT QUESTION_ID, SURVEY_ID, QUESTION_TEXT, QUESTION_TYPE, ORDER_NUM FROM SURVEY_QUESTION WHERE SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId} ORDER BY ORDER_NUM
SELECT OPTION_ID, QUESTION_ID, OPTION_TEXT, ORDER_NUM FROM SURVEY_OPTION WHERE QUESTION_ID = #{questionId} ORDER BY ORDER_NUM
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO SURVEY (SURVEY_ID, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, STATUS, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, END_DATE) VALUES (SURVEY_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{title}, #{description}, 'ACTIVE', #{createdBy}, SYSDATE, #{endDate})
SELECT SURVEY_SEQ.CURRVAL FROM DUAL

INSERT INTO SURVEY_QUESTION (QUESTION_ID, SURVEY_ID, QUESTION_TEXT, QUESTION_TYPE, ORDER_NUM) VALUES (SURVEY_QUESTION_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{surveyId}, #{questionText}, #{questionType}, #{orderNum})
SELECT SURVEY_QUESTION_SEQ.CURRVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SURVEY_OPTION (OPTION_ID, QUESTION_ID, OPTION_TEXT, ORDER_NUM) VALUES (SURVEY_OPTION_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{questionId}, #{optionText}, #{orderNum})

INSERT INTO SURVEY_RESPONSE (RESPONSE_ID, SURVEY_ID, EMPNO, SUBMITTED_AT) VALUES (SURVEY_RESPONSE_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{surveyId}, #{empno}, SYSDATE)
SELECT SURVEY_RESPONSE_SEQ.CURRVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SURVEY_ANSWER (ANSWER_ID, RESPONSE_ID, QUESTION_ID, OPTION_ID, TEXT_VALUE) VALUES (SURVEY_ANSWER_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{responseId}, #{questionId}, #{optionId}, #{textValue})
mapper.update: UPDATE SURVEY SET STATUS = #{status} WHERE SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SURVEY_RESPONSE WHERE SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId} AND EMPNO = #{empno}

SELECT q.QUESTION_ID, q.QUESTION_TEXT, q.QUESTION_TYPE, o.OPTION_ID, o.OPTION_TEXT, COUNT(a.ANSWER_ID) AS ANSWER_COUNT FROM SURVEY_QUESTION q LEFT JOIN SURVEY_OPTION o ON o.QUESTION_ID = q.QUESTION_ID LEFT JOIN SURVEY_ANSWER a ON a.OPTION_ID = o.OPTION_ID WHERE q.SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId} GROUP BY q.QUESTION_ID, q.QUESTION_TEXT, q.QUESTION_TYPE, o.OPTION_ID, o.OPTION_TEXT, q.ORDER_NUM, o.ORDER_NUM ORDER BY q.ORDER_NUM, o.ORDER_NUM

SELECT a.TEXT_VALUE FROM SURVEY_ANSWER a JOIN SURVEY_RESPONSE r ON r.RESPONSE_ID = a.RESPONSE_ID WHERE r.SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId} AND a.QUESTION_ID = #{questionId} AND a.TEXT_VALUE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.SUBMITTED_AT DESC
